summary: Dr. Reddy's Laboratories filed a Form 6-K on August 26, 2026, disclosing the allotment of 4,110 equity shares of Re.1 each to eligible employees upon exercise of stock options under the Dr. Reddy's Employees Stock Option Scheme, 2002. The filing is a routine regulatory disclosure under SEBI Listing Regulations and the Share Based Employee Benefits Regulations. No special-situation event such as a merger, tender offer, spin-off, or restructuring is involved. The allotment is part of ordinary equity compensation administration, with no material impact on shareholders or corporate structure.
